# RPLATE Provisioning Strategy

When Reviver sells an RPLATE digital license plate, both the company and the customer must complete the "Provisioning" process. This procedure is currently highly manual, requiring users to submit photographs of their metal license plate and a valid registration card for verification. I am proposing an incremental improvement to this workflow through the integration of OCR and AI technologies.

## Current Process & Limitations

The existing customer journey involves the following steps:

1. The customer enters their registration state and License Plate Number (LPN) via the mobile app, though LPN spacing is often unreliable.  
2. Reviver uses an API to attempt to retrieve a VIN based on the LPN.  
3. The user provides photos of their physical metal plate and valid registration document.  
4. Admin staff manually populate fields in the Provisioning Queue, such as Plate Design Type and exact LPN formatting.

We are currently limited by our inability to confirm registered owners or automatically determine specific plate design attributes (spaces, half-spaces, or special characters). Additionally, fraud detection currently relies entirely on human intuition when reviewing submitted images.

## Implementation Roadmap

### Phase 1: Operational Enhancement

This phase requires no changes to the mobile app. Instead, it focuses on the "back of house" process by using technology to supplement human data entry.

* Automate the reading of LPNs (including special characters) and Plate Design Types.  
* Use OCR to flag expired or incomplete registration cards.  
* Establish a "kick back" loop where unresolved technical issues are sent to human operators.  
* Implement a regular spot-checking protocol for quality assurance.

### Phase 2: Full Automation

The final objective is to automate the entire provisioning cycle while effectively eliminating the possibility of fraud.

AI Solution to add to the Loop

I have used AI to build the Platez App app as a proof of concept. I want to integrate this powerful processor into the loop. Additionally, I want to build additional modules to Platez to perform the additional checks and automations discussed previously as they apply to the registration document (is this registration up to date? Can we pull all the relevant data into the required fields, etc.)
